text:
tara-cs: HelixMaps demo scheduled for Fri 09:00 PDT. They want a short-lived multi-region allowlist + per-region QPS bump so partners can route traffic through eu-west-2 primarily and ap-south-1 as secondary. Low-friction request; CCing ops. They said renewal interest but currently low risk. CIDRs coming from their infra team.

alex-se: Got CIDRs and cert info from helix infra (support@helixmaps.com). CIDRs: 18.142.56.0/22 (partner pool), 3.8.120.0/23 (partner-ingress). Header: x-hm-demo: true. mTLS cert thumbprint: AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78:90. They want 48h window and auto-revoke. Fallback region -> us-west-2 if capacity constrained.

mila-platform: I can apply this. Proposed per-region config: eu-west-2 => 150 QPS, burst 800; ap-south-1 => 100 QPS, burst 500. Token-level max 80 req/s. Duration 48h auto-revoke. Tag as cs-demo/helixmaps and open ticket CS-8805 before apply. Quick question: keep prefix cache on for demo? They said they may test few dynamic prompts so prefer cache ON.

ryan-sre: Sounds good. Add per-token shaping + global guardrail. I'll add a circuit-breaker rule at 90% capacity that routes to a smaller quantized variant and throttles bursts. Rollback criteria: >3% 5xx over 5m or P95 latency >700ms. I'll review the ticket and approve.

deploy-bot: Change queued: job id #cfg-8910. apply-at 2026-03-25T16:50:00Z.

mila-platform: Applying now to staging for smoke tests. Config snippet (CS-8805):
```yaml
customer: HelixMaps
regions:
  - name: eu-west-2
    qps: 150
    burst: 800
  - name: ap-south-1
    qps: 100
    burst: 500
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 18.142.56.0/22
  - 3.8.120.0/23
headers_allowed:
  - name: x-hm-demo
    value: "true"
mTLS_thumbprint: "AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78:90"
token_level_max: 80
auto_revoke: 2026-03-27T16:50:00Z
tag: cs-demo/helixmaps
fallback_policy:
  primary_order: ["eu-west-2","ap-south-1","us-west-2"]
  circuit_break_threshold: 0.90
  fallback_model: tiny-quant-v2
notes: "prefix_cache: true (customer prefers cache)"
```

ryan-sre: Staging smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in ~3m, will monitor error/latency and post to #eng-oncall if thresholds tripped.

mila-platform: Done 94 allowlist + rate windows live in eu-west-2 & ap-south-1. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-03-27T16:50:00Z. Ticket CS-8805 updated with job id #cfg-8910. Post-demo actions: capture sample prompts/responses, run eval, and log any quality regressions.

tara-cs: Notified customer & partner contacts, sent test instructions and header example. Scheduling 30m post-demo sync Monday to capture feedback. :thumbsup:

mike-am: Added ARR and renewal note to Salesforce (ARR: $45k, renewal Q3). Low risk but interested in Dedicated if partner traffic scales. Please prepare capacity/pricing options if they signal growth.
